page.overview:
Who is Jacunks?

Janks has Future Trunks' hair and Jaco's facial features and Galactic patrolmen armor. He wears purple pants and white boots.

Due to his fusees being part of the Galactic Patrol and Time Patrol, Jacunks is devoted to justice.

Like most EX-Fusions, Jacunks was formed during the Timespace Tournament by the Time Patroller Future Trunks and Galactic Patrolman Jaco by both wearing Bulma's Metamo-Ring then performing the Fusion Dance.

Jacunks is a S-Rank fighter putting his strength on par with EX Gohanks, EX Prillin, Ginyuman, Great Jaco, Great Saiyaman 12, and Kallohan.
